AssumeRole.description_en: Obtains a Security Token Service (STS) token to assume a Resource Access Management (RAM) role
AssumeRole.description_zh: 通过调用AssumeRole接口，获取一个扮演RAM角色的临时身份凭证（STS Token）

AssumeRoleWithOIDC.description_en: Obtains a Security Token Service (STS) token for assuming a RAM role during OIDC-based role SSO by calling the AssumeRoleWithOIDC operation
AssumeRoleWithOIDC.description_zh: 进行OIDC角色SSO时，通过调用AssumeRoleWithOIDC接口，获取扮演RAM角色的临时身份凭证（STS Token）

AssumeRoleWithSAML.description_en: For role-based single sign-on (SSO) that uses Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), call the AssumeRoleWithSAML operation to obtain a temporary identity credential (a Security Token Service (STS) token) for a RAM role
AssumeRoleWithSAML.description_zh: 进行SAML角色SSO时，通过调用AssumeRoleWithSAML接口，获取扮演RAM角色的临时身份凭证（STS Token）

GetCallerIdentity.description_en: A call to the GetCallerIdentity operation returns information about the identity of the current caller
GetCallerIdentity.description_zh: 调用GetCallerIdentity获取当前调用者的身份信息
